export const employeeService = { // fixture wrapper
  async create(input: any, employeeId: string, sapReference: number, requestedRoles: string[]) { // fixture wrapper
// copied from planning-tool/backend/src/services/employee.service.ts lines 1470-1506

    let employee;
    try {
      employee = await prisma.employee.create({
        data: {
          id: employeeId,
          name: composeDisplayName(input.firstName, input.surname),
          firstName: input.firstName,
          surname: input.surname,
          email: input.email,
          sapReference,
          supervisorId: input.supervisorId ?? null,
          organizationalUnitId: input.organizationalUnitId ?? null,
          startDate: new Date(input.startDate),
          endDate: input.endDate ? new Date(input.endDate) : null,
          employeeStatusId: input.employeeStatusId,
          resourceTypeId: input.resourceTypeId,
          roles: { create: requestedRoles.map((role) => ({ role: role as any })) },
        },
        include: EMPLOYEE_INCLUDE,
      });
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (
        typeof err === 'object' && err !== null && 'code' in err
        && (err as { code: string }).code === 'P2002'
      ) {
        const target = (err as { meta?: { target?: string[] } }).meta?.target;
        if (target?.includes('email')) {
          throw new ConflictError('An employee with this email already exists', 'email');
        }
        if (target?.includes('sap_reference')) {
          throw new ConflictError('An employee with this SAP reference already exists', 'sapReference');
        }
        throw new ConflictError('A duplicate record already exists');
      }
      throw err;
    }
  }, // fixture wrapper
  async update(id: string, input: any, existing: any, local: any, organizationAssignmentChanged: boolean, passwordHash: string | undefined, reactivating: boolean) { // fixture wrapper
// copied from planning-tool/backend/src/services/employee.service.ts lines 1925-1953
    const nameFields: Record<string, string> = {};
    if (input.firstName !== undefined || input.surname !== undefined) {
      const newFirstName = input.firstName ?? existing.firstName ?? '';
      const newSurname = input.surname ?? existing.surname ?? '';
      nameFields.name = composeDisplayName(newFirstName, newSurname);
      nameFields.firstName = newFirstName;
      nameFields.surname = newSurname;
    }

    let employee = await local.employee.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        ...nameFields,
        ...(input.email !== undefined && { email: input.email }),
        ...(input.sapReference !== undefined && { sapReference: input.sapReference }),
        ...(input.supervisorId !== undefined && { supervisorId: input.supervisorId }),
        ...(organizationAssignmentChanged && { organizationalUnitId: input.organizationalUnitId }),
        ...(input.startDate !== undefined && { startDate: new Date(input.startDate) }),
        ...(input.endDate !== undefined && { endDate: input.endDate ? new Date(input.endDate) : null }),
        ...(input.employeeStatusId !== undefined && { employeeStatusId: input.employeeStatusId }),
        ...(input.resourceTypeId !== undefined && { resourceTypeId: input.resourceTypeId }),
        ...(passwordHash !== undefined && { passwordHash }),
        // Employee lifecycle is part of effective authority. Reactivation must
        // invalidate stale sessions/capability projections just as
        // deactivation and batch activation do.
        ...(reactivating && { authorityVersion: { increment: 1 } }),
      },
      include: EMPLOYEE_INCLUDE,
    });
  }, // fixture wrapper
  async createUserAsManager(input: any, employee: any, employeeId: string, sapReference: number, requiresCentral: boolean, passwordHash: string) { // fixture wrapper
// copied from planning-tool/backend/src/services/employee.service.ts lines 2105-2186
    if (!employee) {
      const existingEmail = await prisma.employee.findUnique({ where: { email: input.email } });
      if (existingEmail) throw new ConflictError('An employee with this email already exists', 'email');
      try {
        employee = await prisma.employee.create({
          data: {
            id: employeeId,
            name: composeDisplayName(input.firstName, input.surname),
            firstName: input.firstName,
            surname: input.surname,
            email: input.email,
            sapReference,
            organizationalUnitId: input.organizationalUnitId,
            personnelSource: input.personnelSource,
            externalType: input.externalType,
            storageScope: input.storageScope,
            personnelLifecycleState: requiresCentral ? 'PENDING' : 'ACTIVE',
            centralSyncState: requiresCentral ? 'PENDING' : 'NOT_REQUIRED',
            personnelCommandKey: input.idempotencyKey,
            startDate: new Date(input.startDate),
            endDate: input.endDate ? new Date(input.endDate) : null,
            employeeStatusId: input.employeeStatusId,
            resourceTypeId: input.resourceTypeId,
            passwordHash,
            roles: { create: [{ role: 'EMPLOYEE' as AppRole }] },
          },
          include: EMPLOYEE_INCLUDE,
        });
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        if (typeof err === 'object' && err !== null && 'code' in err && (err as { code: string }).code === 'P2002') {
          const target = (err as { meta?: { target?: string[] } }).meta?.target;
          if (target?.includes('email')) throw new ConflictError('An employee with this email already exists', 'email');
          if (target?.includes('sap_reference')) throw new ConflictError('An employee with this SAP reference already exists', 'sapReference');
          throw new ConflictError('A duplicate personnel command already exists.');
        }
        throw err;
      }
    }

    if (requiresCentral && employee) {
      const attemptedAt = new Date();
      try {
        const existingCentral = await centralPrisma.centralEmployee.findUnique({ where: { sapNumber: sapReference }, select: { id: true, email: true } });
        if (existingCentral && existingCentral.email && existingCentral.email !== employee.email) {
          throw new ConflictError('A central employee with this SAP reference belongs to another person.');
        }
        const centralData = {
          sapNumber: sapReference,
          name: composeDisplayName(input.firstName, input.surname),
          firstName: input.firstName,
          surname: input.surname,
          email: employee.email,
          orgUnitId: input.organizationalUnitId,
          active: true,
          personnelSource: input.personnelSource,
          externalType: input.externalType,
          storageScope: 'CENTRAL',
          personnelLifecycleState: 'ACTIVE',
          centralSyncState: 'ACTIVE',
          centralSyncError: null,
          centralSyncAttemptedAt: attemptedAt,
        };
        if (existingCentral) {
          await centralPrisma.centralEmployee.update({ where: { id: existingCentral.id }, data: centralData });
        } else {
          await centralPrisma.centralEmployee.create({ data: centralData });
        }
        employee = await prisma.employee.update({
          where: { id: employee.id },
          data: { personnelLifecycleState: 'ACTIVE', centralSyncState: 'SYNCED', centralSyncError: null, centralSyncAttemptedAt: attemptedAt },
          include: EMPLOYEE_INCLUDE,
        });
      } catch (error) {
        const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
        await prisma.employee.update({
          where: { id: employee.id },
          data: { personnelLifecycleState: 'CENTRAL_FAILED', centralSyncState: 'CENTRAL_FAILED', centralSyncError: message.slice(0, 2000), centralSyncAttemptedAt: attemptedAt },
        });
        if (error instanceof ConflictError) throw error;
        throw new AppError('Central personnel persistence failed; the command remains retryable.', 503, 'CENTRAL_PERSISTENCE_FAILED');
      }
    }
  }, // fixture wrapper
}; // fixture wrapper
